podcasts.name: Moody's Podcasts
podcasts.title: Reframing third-party risk
podcasts.excerpt: Third-party risk programs face growing complexity as organizations become more interconnected and dependent on external partners. Effective programs combine trusted data and technology with transparency, human judgment, and a clear understanding of the organization’s most significant risks. In this episode, Sam Harvey , who leads product strategy for Moody’s across third-party risk and compliance, joins host Alex Pillow to explore practitioner, customer, and vendor perspectives on building a best practice risk management program, the growing role of AI, and why stakeholder communication is essential. Topics discussed: What to prioritize during the first 6–12 months of building a TPRM program from scratch How AI helps uncover connections across large datasets while preserving human judgment for nuanced decisions Designing modular, risk-based solutions around the “identify, assess, treat, monitor, report” lifecycle Why transparency and early communication define strong third-party relationships How organizational maturity shapes the day-to-day responsibilities of a TPRM leader Additional resources: Moody's landing page: Third-party risk management Whitepaper: Connected intelligence: The missing link in third-party risk Podcast: TPRM 101 | Back to basics Hosted by Simplecast, an AdsWizz company. See pcm.adswizz.com for information about our collection and use of personal data for advertising.
